title: Restore default predicate-lock granularity caps to cut SIRead promotion churn
configuration_cause: Incumbent sets max_pred_locks_per_page=0 and max_pred_locks_per_relation=0, forcing the coarsest SIRead granularity on every GetUserTweets scan; r012 showed the opposite extreme (2/-2) was refuted, so the true optimum lies between the extremes and the incumbent's 0/0 extreme is untested against a midpoint.
mechanism: SERIALIZABLE GetUserTweets dominates terminal capacity (0.876) with zero lock waits and zero retries, so predicate-lock bookkeeping cost, not conflict, is the lever. With max_pred_locks_per_page=0 and max_pred_locks_per_relation=0 every scan immediately promotes to relation-level SIRead locks, maximizing per-transaction lock churn and locks_total. r012 tested the opposite extreme (2/-2) and was refuted, indicating the response is non-monotonic. Setting page=1 and relation=1 keeps promotion near the coarse end but avoids the degenerate zero-cap path, testing a distinct interior point on the same granularity axis with a new scalar prediction on locks_total.p95.
query_effect: GetUserTweets index scans retain page-level SIRead locks slightly longer before relation-level promotion, reducing per-transaction lock bookkeeping without introducing lock waits.
expected_tps_effect: Small increase (0.3-1%) if lock bookkeeping is a measurable share of GetUserTweets terminal time; unchanged otherwise.
expected_latency_effect: GetUserTweets p99 flat to slightly lower; no change to p50.

predictions.rationale: Interior granularity caps (1/1) avoid the degenerate zero-cap promotion path that maximizes relation-level SIRead churn at 0/0.
Lower lock bookkeeping per dominant transaction trims tail latency.
Freed terminal capacity from GetUserTweets converts to completed-transaction goodput.
No conflict regime observed (retry ratio 0, lock waits 0); granularity change must not create waits.

alternatives.statement: If the incumbent 0/0 extreme is already optimal, locks_total.p95 will not fall and TPS will be flat or slightly lower, indicating the granularity axis is exhausted and effort should shift to the WAL commit path.
If promotion churn is budget-bound rather than cap-bound, raising max_pred_locks_per_transaction 8192->16384 would lower locks_total.p95 while cap changes do not.

why_exceeds_incumbent: Incumbent sits at the untested degenerate extreme (0/0) of the predicate-lock granularity axis; r012 refuted the opposite extreme (2/-2). An interior point (1/1) is the only remaining untested region and can only help if bookkeeping is the cost driver, with no conflict risk given zero lock waits and zero retries.

knob_changes.numerical_basis: Interior point between incumbent 0 and refuted r012 value 2, within allowed [0,256]; 1 avoids the degenerate zero-cap path while staying near the coarse end.
knob_changes.mechanism_role: page-level predicate-lock granularity cap; 1 retains page-level SIRead locks one step longer than 0 before promotion

knob_changes.numerical_basis: Interior point between incumbent 0 and refuted r012 value -2, within allowed [-2,4096]; positive cap of 1 relation-level lock avoids the zero-cap degenerate path.
knob_changes.mechanism_role: relation-level predicate-lock granularity cap; 1 caps relation-level SIRead locks at one before promotion

nodes.label: Interior SIRead granularity avoids degenerate zero-cap promotion churn
